source_name: EFFIS / Copernicus Fire Weather Index forecast
text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 28.7 — 'high' on the EFFIS scale — at Alcanadre (stage 9) on 2026-10-10, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-10-10. 5 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Alcanadre (stage 9) 29, Alagón (stage 14) 26, Bujaraloz (stage 18) 25, Alcanadre (stage 9) 24, Calahorra (stage 10) 23, Alcanadre (stage 9) 22. FWI anomaly at Alcanadre is +3.3 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
